subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Eccentricity
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Eccentricity"** means the quality of being unconventional and slightly strange. (असामान्यता)

 
 
• **Example:** His **eccentricity** was evident in his unusual choice of clothing.
 
 
 
• **"Mannerism"** refers to a habitual gesture or way of speaking or behaving. (आदत)
 
 
• **Example:** Her** mannerism** of twirling her hair when she is nervous is quite noticeable.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that a synonym for **"Eccentricity"** is **"Mannerism"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Deception** (धोखा): The act of deceiving someone.

 
 
• **Example:** His deception was discovered when the truth came out.
 
 
 
• **Regularity** (नियमितता): The state of being regular or consistent.
 
 
• **Example:** Regularity in exercise leads to better health.
 
 
 
• **Jeopardy** (खतरा): Danger of loss, harm, or failure.
 
 
• **Example:** His actions put the mission in jeopardy.
